heading: Purchase of low-enriched uranium derived from Russian highly enriched uranium

tree.heading: Sense of Congress
tree.text: It is the sense of Congress that the allies of the United States and other nations should participate in efforts to ensure that stockpiles of weapons-grade nuclear material are reduced.

tree.heading: Actions by Secretary of State
tree.text: Congress urges the Secretary of State to encourage, in consultation with the Secretary of Energy, other countries to purchase low-enriched uranium that is derived from highly enriched uranium extracted from Russian nuclear weapons.
